description: Defines the PartialTheme class in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin, representing a partial theme configuration with methods to create instances from Theme entities and access properties.

classes.name: PartialTheme
classes.description: Represents a partial theme configuration with identifiers, visual elements, and utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new PartialTheme instance with provided theme data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the theme.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the variables associated with the theme.

methods.name: showSocialMediaIcons
methods.description: Indicates whether social media icons should be shown.

methods.name: getClientLogoFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the client logo.

methods.name: getClientBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the client banner.

methods.name: getLoginBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the login banner.

methods.name: createFromTheme
methods.description: Creates a PartialTheme instance from a Theme entity.
